title: Flow-Controlled Scheduling for LLM Inference with Provable Stability Guarantees
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Performance modeling, Queueing theory

problem_statement.en: Real-world LLM inference faces stochastic arrivals with heterogeneous input and output lengths; aggregate KV-cache memory under continuous batching fluctuates sharply and can trigger preemption or dropping, yet existing scheduling logic is heuristic and lacks provable stability guarantees.
problem_statement.zh: 真實世界 LLM 推理面對隨機到達與異質輸入/輸出長度，continuous batching 下 KV cache 聚合用量劇烈波動，易觸發搶佔或丟棄；既有 scheduling 策略多為啟發式，缺乏可證明的穩定性保證。

key_innovation.en: A discrete-time token-level queueing model of an LLM serving system with a KV-cache budget M, plus a flow-control admission policy that caps activation rate per request class to b_k > lambda_k. Derives a necessary condition for stability of any policy and proves sufficient conditions under which the proposed policy attains stability; Nested LIFO eviction handles unknown output lengths.
key_innovation.zh: 建立離散時間 token-level queueing 模型刻畫 KV cache 預算 M 之 LLM 服務系統，並提出 flow-control admission 策略，將每類別請求啟用速率限制為 b_k > lambda_k。導出任意策略穩定的必要條件，並證明該策略於充分條件下達穩定；未知輸出長度時採 LIFO 驅逐處理。

baselines_compared: alpha-protection greedy, MC benchmark, MC-SF, Amin algorithm, Hindsight optimal (Gurobi)

key_improvements.en: Outperforms alpha-greedy, MC benchmark, MC-SF (known output) and Amin (unknown output) on average latency, P95 latency, request throughput, and token throughput across all simulated T in [200, 1000]; achieves performance close to hindsight-optimal integer-programming solution.
key_improvements.zh: 在 T 介於 200 至 1000 的所有模擬區間，於平均延遲、P95 延遲、request throughput 與 token throughput 皆優於 alpha-greedy、MC benchmark、MC-SF（已知輸出）與 Amin（未知輸出）；性能接近 Gurobi 求解的 hindsight-optimal 整數規劃解。

reported_accuracy: Theoretical: overflow events bounded by T * exp(-C(A, epsilon) M^2)
models_validated: Llama-2-70B (scale reference for M = 16492 on 2x A100)
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Poisson arrivals, three prefill/decode classes), real-world dataset with over 210000 prompts (50000 sampled)

scope_assumptions.en: Discrete time-slotted model on a single computational worker with hard KV-cache budget M = 16492 (matching Llama-2-70B on 2x A100). Continuous-time evaluation uses Microsoft Vidur for process times; Poisson arrivals throughout. Algorithm 2 requires bounded input/output lengths. Activation budget b is grid-searched; small b is conservative, large b degenerates to greedy with LIFO eviction.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單一運算節點離散時隙模型，硬性 KV cache 預算 M = 16492（對應 Llama-2-70B 於 2x A100）；連續時間評估採 Microsoft Vidur 計算 process time，且全篇假設 Poisson 到達。Algorithm 2 要求輸入/輸出長度有上界。啟用預算 b 採網格搜尋：b 過小則保守、b 過大則退化為 greedy 加 LIFO 驅逐。
